title: Service Writer Apologies for Incorrect or Mixed Information
summary: This topic centers on service writers apologizing for incorrect information, mixed messages, or an extra service visit, with most excerpts not clearly indicating the customer’s overall sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive feedback mentions a writer apologizing and constructively recommending that the customer schedule service.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined excerpts describe apologies for incorrect information, mixed messages, feedback handling, or an unnecessary service visit without enough context to classify the overall experience.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts are too brief to determine whether the apology resolved the issue or how the customer ultimately felt.
The topic is narrow and based on short service-related fragments, so examples are insufficient to draw broader conclusions beyond the specific apology scenarios shown.
